Ist eine Versiegelung beim Neuwagen sinn: Is sealing a new car worthwhile?

Was sind Swirls und wie entstehen sie?: What are swirls and how do they form?
Swirls sind feine, meist kreisförmige Kr: Swirls are fine, mostly circular scratches in the clear coat, caused by friction with dirt particles. Every grain of sand dragged across the paint during washing leaves a tiny mark. Many of these marks together create the typical pattern that becomes visible in sunlight or under LED light.
Besonders deutlich sieht man Swirls auf: Swirls show up most clearly on dark and solid-colour paints. On silver or white they are harder to see, but they are still there. They make the paint look duller, because light is no longer reflected evenly.
Woran erkennen Sie Swirls an Ihrem Auto?: How can you spot swirls on your car?
Swirls erkennen Sie am besten bei direkt: The best way to spot swirls is in direct sunlight or with a bright torch. Hold the torch at an angle, close to a clean surface such as the bonnet. If you see fine, circular lines around the point of light, there are swirls. Straight lines in one direction tend to point to scratches from squeegeeing or drying with too much rubbing. Individual deep scratches that you can feel with your fingernail usually reach into deeper layers of paint and can often only be reduced by polishing.
Verursacht die Waschstraße Kratzer im La: Does an automatic car wash scratch the paint?
Ja, eine Waschstraße kann Kratzer verurs: Yes, an automatic car wash can cause scratches, especially on very dirty cars. The brushes or cloth strips come into contact with dirt that has not yet been fully loosened. This dirt is then moved across the paint under pressure.
Moderne Anlagen mit Textilwaschelementen: Modern car washes with textile washing elements are often gentler than older brush systems. But the risk depends heavily on how thorough the pre-wash is and how well the system is maintained. As a customer, you can hardly judge this from the outside. On top of that, a car wash only roughly follows the shape of your car. Wheels, door shuts and areas under spoilers often stay dirty.

Tipps für die Autowäsche zuhause: Tips for washing your car at home

Use separate cloths for paint, wheels and interior, ideally in different colours. This prevents brake dust from the wheels getting onto the paint. Old cotton cloths, sponges and chamois leathers are less suitable for paint, because they tend to push dirt along in front of them.
